clips.title: The story
paras: In Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits, Ur'kyo guides priests in the ways of shadow and light. The Darkspear regard him as their spiritual leader and greatest priest, and he teaches their traditions in the Horde capital.

Ur'kyo guides Darkspear mystics and visiting practitioners from the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar. After fleeing the Echo Isles, the Darkspear made a home in Durotar alongside Thrall's Horde. Their sacred traditions remain vital to the tribe, and Ur'kyo keeps those ancestral practices alive through his teaching.

Priests who come to Ur'kyo find a patient instructor in faith and old rites. He teaches the Hex of Weakness and the defensive ward called Shadowguard. Horde priests also turn to him to learn about the coalition's varied spiritual ways, from troll voodoo and ancestral customs to foreign disciplines.
